Poor Tragic Eight Ball. I guess he didn't have

 I do.
postload_actions.cage: Uh huh! As long as I'm in here you're just going to sit out there, aren'cha?

Now that I have the crowbar, will I finally be able to escape this place? Signs point... 
 to maybe!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: OH AND THEY'D BETTER NOT BE SCENTED. THE ONLY SMELLS ALLOWED IN HELL ARE 'SULFUR', 'BRIMSTONE', AND 'FOETID MILDEW'.

default_actions.text: You've literally done nothing but project your voice at me since I met you, Baal.

default_actions.text: A metal hatch of some kind... I wonder if Morven hid any of his stolen goods underground?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: UNDERGROUND...? WE'RE ON THE BOTTOM FLOOR OF OFFICE HELL, THAT'S GOTTA BE SOME KIND OF COSMIC BEDROCK.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THAT'S DEFINITELY NOT A PA SYSTEM. MY MIGHTY VOICE IS OMNIPRESENT! YOU PROBABLY LEFT THAT UP THERE AND FORGOT ABOUT IT.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
